defects: Integrability hypothesis is global (`MeasureTheory.Integrable f`, integrable on all of ℝ) instead of gold's `IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0)` (integrable only on (0,∞)); this is a strictly stronger/different requirement that excludes functions integrable on (0,∞) but not on all of ℝ, and is not implied by the other hypotheses
Nonnegativity is required on [0,∞) (`∀ x ≥ 0, 0 ≤ f x`) rather than gold's open ray (0,∞) (`∀ t ∈ Ioi 0, 0 ≤ f t`), a minor extra constraint at the point x = 0 not present in gold
